'''Vi Fortuna''', a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] of [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] descent, was a cleaner at a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Unidentified Podracing hangar (Mos Eisley)|hangar]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Kinect" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The "Destiny" mode of the Podracing episode of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'' dates itself to around ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] won his freedom in. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, in which Skywalker wins the race, to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, the "Destiny" mode must occur around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> racers racing in the [[Outer Rim Regional Podracing Circuit]], a circuit with a course in Mos Eisley, used the facility.<ref name="Kinect" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, you know your way around mop, but forget all that. That's your old life. You are PODRACER now, get it? Podracer is tough&hellip; maybe a little crazy. Most of all, Podracer is FAST.|Watto to Vi Fortuna, should Fortuna be chosen as the player's character|<ref name="Kinect" />}}
Vi Fortuna appeared in the [[2012]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', a game used with the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] console's [[Wikipedia:Kinect|Kinect]] system. Fortuna can be selected as a playable character in the "Destiny" mode of the game's Podracing episode.<ref name="Kinect" />

Should the character be chosen, the introductory cutscene shows the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], manager of the Podracing team [[Team Watto]], taking notice of Fortuna, who is sweeping a broom in the hangar. Watto, whose Podracing pilot has turned up missing, flies over to the Twi'lek and tells Fortuna that they will race for him the day afterwards, but that he would find a real pilot later. Watto instructs Fortuna to begin their training and orders them to leave the hangar.<ref name="Kinect" />
